items.summary_zh: 【美海军第五舰队司令访问以色列】财联社11月13日电，以色列国防军13日发表声明称，美国海军第五舰队司令柯特·伦肖当天结束对以色列的访问

items.title: Guangdong holds a low altitude economy matchmaking forum in Beijing
items.title_zh: 广东省低空经济产业对接推介座谈会在北京举办
items.summary: CLS, 13 November: according to the Guangdong Development and Reform Commission, the province held a low altitude economy matchmaking and promotion forum in Beijing on 11 November to deepen cross regional coordination and bring quality companies into Guangdong to build a Greater Bay Area low altitude economy hub.
items.summary_zh: 【广东省低空经济产业对接推介座谈会在北京举办】财联社11月13日电，据广东省发改委消息，为抢抓低空经济发展机遇，深化低空经济产业跨区域协同联动，推动全国优质低空经济企业走进广东、共建粤港澳大湾区低空经济高地，11月11日，广东省发展改革委在北京举办广东省低空经济产业对接推介座谈会

items.title: Xinghu Technology: controlling shareholder to buy 75 to 150 million yuan of shares
items.title_zh: 星湖科技：控股股东拟增持7500万元至1.5亿元股份
items.summary: CLS, 13 November: Xinghu Technology (600866.SH) announced that controlling shareholder Guangxin Group plans to buy shares through centralized bidding within 12 months of disclosure, for at least 75 million and at most 150 million yuan, capped at 2 percent of total share capital, funded by its own capital and a dedicated bank lending facility for shareholder purchases.
items.summary_zh: 【星湖科技：控股股东拟增持7500万元至1.5亿元股份】财联社11月13日电，星湖科技(600866.SH)公告称，公司控股股东广新集团计划自公告披露之日起12个月内，通过集中竞价方式增持公司股份，增持金额不低于7500万元、不超过1.5亿元，增持比例不超过总股本2%，资金来源为自有资金及金融机构增持专项贷款

items.title: Tianpu, up the limit for 4 sessions, gains 54.73 percent since 9 November and halts for a review from 16 November
items.title_zh: 4连板天普股份：自11月9日起股价累计上涨54.73% 11月16日起停牌核查
items.summary: CLS, 13 November: Tianpu (605255.SH) announced its shares rose by the daily limit for 4 consecutive sessions from 10 to 13 November 2026, gaining 54.73 percent since 9 November.
items.summary_zh: 【4连板天普股份：自11月9日起股价累计上涨54.73% 11月16日起停牌核查】财联社11月13日电，天普股份(605255.SH)公告称，公司股票自2026年11月10日至11月13日连续4个交易日涨停，自11月9日起股价累计上涨54.73%

items.title: CLS, 13 November: Novo Nordisk files for approval of etavopivat with the FDA and EMA
items.title_zh: 财联社11月13日电，诺和诺德向美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）和欧洲药品管理局（EMA）提交了依他匹伐（etavopivat）的上市申请，Etavopivat使血管闭塞危象减少27...
items.summary: CLS, 13 November: Novo Nordisk has filed marketing applications for etavopivat with the US Food and Drug Administration and the European Medicines Agency; etavopivat reduced vaso occlusive crises by 27 percent and delayed the first crisis by about 4 months.
items.summary_zh: 财联社11月13日电，诺和诺德向美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）和欧洲药品管理局（EMA）提交了依他匹伐（etavopivat）的上市申请，Etavopivat使血管闭塞危象减少27%，首次血管闭塞危象延迟约4个月

items.title: CLS, 13 November: grain exports through Baltic and Arctic ports rose ninefold
items.title_zh: 财联社11月13日电，数据显示，通过波罗的海和北极港口的粮食出口增长了九倍。
items.summary: CLS, 13 November: data showed grain exports through the Baltic and Arctic ports rose ninefold.
items.summary_zh: 财联社11月13日电，数据显示，通过波罗的海和北极港口的粮食出口增长了九倍

items.title: Who can replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO? These four names are buzzing in AI circles.
items.title_zh: 谁能接替黄仁勋出任英伟达 CEO？这四个名字在 AI 圈内被热议
items.summary: As Nvidia’s board seeks a new CEO, experts say that person will need a rare balance of tech vision and business savvy
items.summary_zh: 在英伟达董事会寻找新 CEO 之际，专家表示此人需要在技术远见与商业嗅觉之间取得罕见的平衡。

items.title: ST Hengxin: a cancelled company seal was misused and legal action has been started
items.title_zh: ST恒信：已作废公章被冒用 已启动法律追责程序
items.summary: CLS, 13 November: ST Hengxin (300081.SZ) announced that company seal number 1301000919690 was declared void by law on 31 July 2026.
items.summary_zh: 【ST恒信：已作废公章被冒用 已启动法律追责程序】财联社11月13日电，ST恒信(300081.SZ)公告称，公司编号为1301000919690的公章已于2026年7月31日依法声明作废

items.title: CLS, 13 November: Tata Motors posts a second quarter loss of 55.3 billion rupees against an expected profit of 14.99 billion
items.title_zh: 财联社11月13日电，塔塔汽车第二季度亏损553亿卢比，市场预计利润为149.9亿卢比。
items.summary: CLS, 13 November: Tata Motors reported a second quarter loss of 55.3 billion rupees, where the market had expected a profit of 14.99 billion rupees.
items.summary_zh: 财联社11月13日电，塔塔汽车第二季度亏损553亿卢比，市场预计利润为149.9亿卢比

items.title: Nvidia down 30 percent: is this the buying opportunity? Wall Street keeps warning
items.title_zh: 英伟达暴跌30% 现在是抄底良机？华尔街警告声迭起！
items.summary: Nvidia shares have stayed under pressure from the Huang affair, and with his resignation as CEO the stock is now more than 30 percent below the record high of 239.24 dollars set on 6 October.
items.summary_zh: 近日，全球芯片龙头 英伟达 的股价因“黄仁勋风波”持续承压，而随着黄仁勋辞去CEO一职，该公司的股价已从10月6日创下的239.24美元的历史高点下跌超过30%
